title: Recover State on Error
goal: Return the original value inside Err when a state transition fails.
hints: Think about what happens to ownership of the door if unlock fails.
Return the original self inside the Err variant so the caller gets it back.
explanation: Returning `self` in `Err(self)` yields ownership of the original `Door` struct back to the caller when authentication fails. Returning a `String` or `()` consumes the door permanently and causes compile errors (`E0609`) when attempting to access `Door` fields on the returned error value in tests.
